title: China's 2,800 km Northwest Loop: Lakes, Salt Flats, Rainbow Hills | China Travel Expert
description:
One drive strings together the wildest landscapes in China's northwest.

The Qinghai–Gansu Grand Loop is roughly 2,800 km, usually done in 7–10 days. It rings Qinghai Lake — China's largest lake, sitting at about 3,260 m — then rolls through high grassland, mirror-flat salt lakes, Gobi desert, and the rainbow-striped Danxia hills near Zhangye. Because you spend days above 3,000 m, altitude is the thing to plan around.

🧭 Expert Tip: drive the loop clockwise to stay a step ahead of the tour buses, and give your first day to acclimating before you climb higher.

青甘大环线：约2800公里，环着中国最大的湖，一路草原、盐湖、彩色丹霞。
